note: The Rootway. Endpoints, class and path length are RI-WLD01 §4; the ROUTE between them is A* over the built terrain, so the road goes round the ridge and crosses at the narrows. Each leg carries its own elevation profile and the game blends the ground to it, which is what makes a causeway a causeway instead of a decal on a marsh.
